RUN JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=1; JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=1; while [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -le "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; do PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 /bin/sh -lc 'pip3 install beautifulsoup4==4.9.3 requests==2.25.1 openai python-dotenv selenium==4.25.0 webdriver-manager==4.0.2 pytest -q' && JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=0 && break; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=$?; (python -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || python3 -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || true); if [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -eq "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"; fi; JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=$((JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT + 1)); sleep 5; done; exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"
